lines.notes: Indore Metro Phase 1 comprises Line 3 (Yellow Line) designed as a 33.53 km circular ring corridor with 29 stations. The initial 17.0 km priority stretch from Gandhi Nagar to Radisson Square (16 stations) is operational. Remaining elevated and underground sections completing the ring loop are under active construction.
